WARPED.gloss: used especially of timbers or boards

WARPED.example: The floors were warped and cracked.

RAPED.gloss: having been robbed and destroyed by force and violence
RAPED.definition: Having been robbed and destroyed by force and violence.

PADRE.gloss: a chaplain in one of the military services
PADRE.definition: A chaplain in one of the military services.

READ.gloss: interpret something that is written or printed
READ.definition: Interpret something that is written or printed.

WEAR.example: She was wearing yellow that day.

ARE.gloss: a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
ARE.definition: A unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters.

WAR.gloss: the waging of armed conflict against an enemy
WAR.definition: The waging of armed conflict against an enemy.
WAR.example: Thousands of people were killed in the war.

RED.definition: Red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood.

ERA.gloss: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

RAW.gloss: being unprocessed or manufactured using only simple or minimal processes
